meta.textSample: WE'LL BE AT AUTOMATE 2026! Home What We're Automating Partner With Us About Company The Future of Physical Labor. ∙WAREHOUSE AUTOMATION Yondu provides drop-in, general-purpose robots for 3PL warehouses to automate high-turnover labor and deliver fast, ROI-positive automation without new infrastructure. s s g u z d d g s r Automation shouldn't be out of reach; it should evolve with your business and fit seamlessly into the way you already work. Toggle Through To View All Our Current Applications (2x Speed) See Everything We Are Automating! Yondu Automates The Full Range Of Repetitive Physical Warehouse Workflows. Focused on Innovation Yondu is the first company to fully automate brownfield bin-picking, along with other critical warehouse tasks, at a price point mid-sized warehouses can afford. Our system works within existing layouts and processes, eliminating the need for costly retrofits or new infrastructure. Revolutionary Research With Yondu, warehouses can cut labor costs by up to 75%, reduce errors and lost inventory, handle seasonal demand with ease, and maintain reliable 24/7 operations. That frees teams to focus on growth, while automation handles the heavy lifting. With Yondu, integration is seamless: our robots adapt to the warehouse you already have, working within your current layout and processes so you can automate without halting operations or investing in new infrastructure. Warehouses that can automate bin-picking will deliver better service, drastically lower costs, and stand out from competitors. Yondu is a brownfield installation so you don’t have to change any of your existing infrastructure. Yondu’s AI robots navigate shelves, identify items, and pick and place any SKU within your existing warehouse layout. In this video We introduce Yondu AI co-founder Michael Chen and Tahmid Jamal break down the many dimensions of their work, from the challenges they're solving today to the long-term vision shaping the future of robotics and warehouse automation. RUNTIME 5:41 We envision a future where all manual tasks are done by robots. A future where businesses reallocate labor towards higher impact tasks. Drop In Warehouse Automation Warehouse Automation Embodied AI Platform Brownfield Automation Through Robot Learning Yondu is the first company to fully automate brownfield warehouse tasks at a price point any warehouse can afford. Our approach brings advanced robotics into existing operations without costly infrastructure changes, making automation accessible to businesses of every size. Get In Touch You get a seamless path to next-generation automation with no costly rebuilds, no SKU limits, just smarter operations to scale with your business. Partnership with Shipbots Yondu has had a close partnership with Shipbots one of the largest and most tech forward 3PLs on the West Coast. We’re working with them to test, iterate, and roll out our bin-picking robots in their warehouse. Reach out to our team Whether you’re planning next steps or fine tuning operations, we're here to help. Bring us your tasks and we'll make them hands-free. CONTACT OUR TEAM hello@yonduai.com +1-904-325-3099 z z z z i i z z Control. Learn. Automate. From pilot to production, we turn robots into a coordinated workforce for any warehouse job. changing the way the world works. HQ Located in Gardena, CA Copyright © 2025 Yondu Inc. All Rights Reserved.

meta.textSample: WE'LL BE AT AUTOMATE 2026! Home What We're Automating Partner With Us About Company A Team Of Hackers. We're obsessed with building the future of physical labor s s g u z d d g s r At Yondu, we are revolutionizing physical labor by building the robot workforce of the future. We empower businesses to lower operating costs, eliminate turnover, and increase efficiency. We do all this by leveraging breakthroughs in robot learning and the rapid commercialization of general purpose robot hardware. Our History We've built our growth on collaboration, a spirit of experimentation, and a belief in the value of long-term thinking. DEC 2023 Yondu Founded at MIT FEB 2024 Participated in the PROD 3.0 and YC W24 cohorts MAY 2024 Closed seed round and built first embodied AI demo NOV 2024 Landed First Design Partnership JAN 2025 Began work with Shipbots to develop our bin-picking application JUN 2025 Opened Yondu HQ and landed pilot contract SEP 2025 Demonstrated Comprehensive Tele-operated Bin-Picking System FUTURE Building the future of physical labor At Yondu We Have Cultural Pillars That Make Working Here Exciting, Fun, And Unique. Speak Up: We debate, speak up and do it without worry, no matter who's in the room—problems get raised fast, and the best ideas win. Relentless Learning: We always read the most recent papers, keep up with the state of the art, and continually learn and improve our skills. Curiosity drives us forward, ensuring we're always evolving with the field and pushing beyond the known edge. Flat Structure: Founders and everyone work equally on the same problems without exception. We never ask anyone to do anything you wouldn't do yourself. This creates an environment where responsibility is shared, and everyone has a direct impact on our success. Passion For Robotics: We're obsessed with building robots that push the limits of what’s possible and think what we do is super cool. For us, robotics isn't just technology; it's also creativity, curiosity, and craft in motion. Exciting Mission: We're tackling one of the hardest problems in robot learning—bringing humanoid robots into the real world to solve urgent needs. Underdog Mindset: We understand we’re a startup and always punch above our weight to compete with companies much larger than ours. We embrace challenges with resourcefulness and determination, turning our size into an advantage. Grit & Resillience We stay steady under pressure, adapt when things don’t go as planned, and keep pushing forward until the problem is solved. Having Fun: We laugh as hard as we work—because building the future is only worth it if we enjoy the ride together. Fun isn't extra—it's how we stay curious, creative, and unstoppable. Based in Los Angeles, CA Yondu AI is rooted in Los Angeles, where we partner directly with local customers to refine and deploy our technology while we build the foundation for expansion. LOCATION Gardena, CA CONTACT hello@yonduai.com +14159078109 z z z z i i z z Control. Learn. Automate. From pilot to production, we turn robots into a coordinated workforce for any warehouse job. changing the way the world works. HQ Located in Gardena, CA Copyright © 2025 Yondu Inc. All Rights Reserved.
